records.summary_researcher: A current Chabad.org thematic article identifies Igrot Kodesh vol. 27 p. 101 as a letter to a young widow who lost her husband and asked for advice concerning her children. The article reports that the response includes encouraging social contact for the children. The printed letter/item page and incoming correspondence have not yet been checked in this repository.
